items.name: time
items.title: Time
items.description: Renders an instant as readable Chinese text (12 分钟前, 今天 14:05) inside a <time> element, with a tooltip giving the exact local time to the millisecond, the UTC time and the relative time; screen readers get the exact local time too. Props: value (Date | ISO string | epoch ms), clock (bare HH:mm:ss), seconds, placeholder, delay.

items.name: tone-badge
items.title: ToneBadge
items.description: Status badge with a tone: success, error, info, warning, neutral or outline. Tinted backgrounds keep the text at 4.5:1 or better in both themes; the word always states the status, so it never relies on color alone. Map domain states (failed, running, …) to tones at the call site.

items.name: notice
items.title: Notice
items.description: Page-level notice built on Alert: tone error (announced as an alert), warning or neutral, with an optional title, description and one trailing action such as a retry button.

items.name: empty-state
items.title: EmptyState
items.description: Frameless empty, no-access or error panel built on Empty: icon, title, description and a contents slot for the way out. size="sm" fits an empty table body or list.

items.name: copy-button
items.title: CopyButton
items.description: Icon-only copy button: copies text, cross-fades the copy icon to a check for 1.5 s and switches its accessible name to 已复制. Props: text, label (default 复制), copiedLabel, variant, size.

items.name: theme-provider
items.title: ThemeProvider
items.description: ThemeProvider and useTheme(): system, light or dark, remembered in localStorage (storageKey), applied as the dark class and data-theme on <html> with transitions suppressed during the switch. scoped removes both on unmount, for an app mounted inside a site with its own palette.

items.name: meter
items.title: Meter
items.description: A labelled meter for a value against its ceiling, such as in-flight work against a cap: label and figures on one line, a thin track under them, role=meter with valueText as the spoken value.

items.name: person-avatar
items.title: PersonAvatar
items.description: A person's picture, or up to two initials while it is missing or loading. Hidden from screen readers; render the name beside it.

items.name: form-input
items.title: FormInput
items.description: A labelled text input with a hint and an error, both linked through aria-describedby, aria-invalid while there is an error, and a required marker. Accepts every input prop.

items.name: search-field
items.title: SearchField
items.description: A 28px toolbar search input with a magnifier and a clear button; Escape clears a non-empty field. label is the accessible name.

items.name: filter-select
items.title: FilterSelect
items.description: A 28px select for filtering a list; the trigger reads "<label> <choice>" and the first option, allLabel (全部), means no filter (value "").

items.name: pager
items.title: Pager
items.description: Paging controls under a table: the range shown (第 1–50 条，共 173 条), an optional page-size select, first/previous/next/last buttons and a page field. Zero-based; folds back to the last page when the total shrinks. All text comes from the labels prop.

items.name: table-kit
items.title: Table kit
items.description: Helpers for open tables built on the shadcn table: TableScroll (scrolls both ways, no rules between body rows, pins the header), TableHeaderRow (compact muted pinned header), TableRows (loading, empty and rows states), ClickableRow (whole-row click forwarded to the row's first link or button, selected and warning/error tints) and clickFirstControl.

items.name: page-layout
items.title: Page layout
items.description: Frameless page structure: Page (document or fill-height, optional narrow width), PageHeader (h1 with badges, actions and a meta line, or a screen-reader-only title), Section (heading over open content), FactLine (dot-separated facts), Facts (label over value) and StatStrip (headline figures, colored only when they need action).

items.name: confirm-dialog
items.title: ConfirmDialog
items.description: An alert dialog for irreversible or outward-facing writes: title, description and a confirm button that repeats the verb. It stays open and cannot be dismissed while onConfirm runs, shows a rejection's message inside, and closes only on success.

items.name: toaster
items.title: AppToaster
items.description: AppToaster (a toast region with the region and close buttons named in Chinese) and notify(title, { description, type }) for success toasts that close after 4 s and error toasts that are announced at once and stay.
